title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Lifestyle and Opinion Support
prompt: In many countries, people are increasingly choosing to spend more time and money on experiences such as travel, dining out, and attending events rather than on material possessions. Some people believe that this shift towards experiential consumption leads to greater personal happiness and stronger social connections. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，明确表达你的立场（同意或不同意），并在文章中展开论证。你需要讨论体验式消费是否带来更多个人幸福和更强的社会联系，并给出理由和例子。文章长度至少250词。
